headline: Brazil Central Bank Reports Slowing Credit Growth and Higher Loan Costs
summary: Brazil's central bank reported that 12-month credit growth slowed to 7.8% while the average rate on new loans rose to 32.9%.
why: Slowing credit expansion and rising borrowing costs indicate tighter financial conditions for consumers and businesses.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Higher loan interest rates and decelerating credit growth dampen domestic consumption and investment.
